# Image

Image with a placeholder while loading, a fallback when loading fails, and a larger preview on click. The preview
is FilePreview with this one image: it grows out of the image onto a neutral viewer background (the `viewer-*`
tokens, the viewer background step of ThemeProvider), so the colors of the image are not affected by the theme.
For many images use ImageGrid with FilePreview or Lightbox.

**Interaction**: the image fades in when it has loaded. With preview, the image is a button: `Tab` focuses it and
shows the focus ring, hovering shows a magnifier, and a click or `Enter` / `Space` open the preview. In the
preview, the image zooms with the wheel, a pinch, `+` / `-` or a double click and is dragged when zoomed; focus
stays inside it, `Esc` (or dragging the image up or down) closes it, the image flies back into place, and focus
returns to the image.

**Category**: Media · **Common uses**: Thumbnails in detail pages and forms, cover images, images in messages

## Import

```ts
import { Image } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Give the image a `width` and `height`: the placeholder keeps the area while it loads, then the image fades in.
Click it, or press `Enter`, to open the preview on the neutral viewer background.

```tsx
import { Image } from 'vellum-ui'

interface SampleImage {
  readonly id: string
  readonly src: string
  readonly alt: string
  readonly placeholderColor: string
}

function sampleImages(count: number): SampleImage[] {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const hue = (i * 47) % 360
    const bg = `oklch(0.78 0.06 ${hue})`
    const fg = `oklch(0.45 0.09 ${(hue + 40) % 360})`
    const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400"><rect width="400" height="400" fill="${bg}"/><circle cx="${120 + ((i * 37) % 160)}" cy="${140 + ((i * 53) % 120)}" r="${60 + (i % 5) * 14}" fill="${fg}" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M0 ${300 - (i % 7) * 10} Q200 ${220 + (i % 9) * 8} 400 ${290 - (i % 4) * 12} L400 400 L0 400Z" fill="${fg}" opacity="0.5"/></svg>`
    return {
      id: `sample-${i}`,
      src: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`,
      alt: `Sample image ${i + 1}`,
      placeholderColor: bg,
    }
  })
}

const [first, second] = sampleImages(2)

export function Basic() {
  return <Image src={first?.src} alt={first?.alt} width={160} height={120} />
}
```

## Variants

### Fit, radius and no preview

`fit="contain"` shows the whole image, `radius` sets the corners and `preview={false}` turns off the preview.

```tsx
import { Image, Inline } from 'vellum-ui'

interface SampleImage {
  readonly id: string
  readonly src: string
  readonly alt: string
  readonly placeholderColor: string
}

function sampleImages(count: number): SampleImage[] {
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const hue = (i * 47) % 360
    const bg = `oklch(0.78 0.06 ${hue})`
    const fg = `oklch(0.45 0.09 ${(hue + 40) % 360})`
    const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400"><rect width="400" height="400" fill="${bg}"/><circle cx="${120 + ((i * 37) % 160)}" cy="${140 + ((i * 53) % 120)}" r="${60 + (i % 5) * 14}" fill="${fg}" opacity="0.8"/><path d="M0 ${300 - (i % 7) * 10} Q200 ${220 + (i % 9) * 8} 400 ${290 - (i % 4) * 12} L400 400 L0 400Z" fill="${fg}" opacity="0.5"/></svg>`
    return {
      id: `sample-${i}`,
      src: `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`,
      alt: `Sample image ${i + 1}`,
      placeholderColor: bg,
    }
  })
}

const [first, second] = sampleImages(2)

export function Variants() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={4}>
      <Image src={second?.src} alt={second?.alt} width={160} height={96} fit="contain" />
      <Image src={second?.src} alt={second?.alt} width={96} height={96} radius="lg" />
      <Image
        src={first?.src}
        alt={first?.alt}
        width={96}
        height={96}
        radius="none"
        preview={false}
      />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## States

### Loading and failed

While loading, a neutral placeholder covers the area; when the image fails to load, a fallback replaces it and the
image cannot be previewed.

```tsx
import { Image, Inline } from 'vellum-ui'

export function States() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={4}>
      {/* An image that cannot be decoded: fails without a network request */}
      <Image src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" alt="Missing photo" width={160} height={120} />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | Address of the image, passed to `<img>` as it is. | — | No |
| `alt` | `string` | Text alternative of the image, read by screen readers; it is also the accessible name of the preview button. Use an empty string only for decorative images without preview. | — | No |
| `placeholder` | `ReactNode` | Shown over the image area while it loads: a neutral fill by default; `false` shows nothing. Give the image a `width` and `height` so that the area keeps its size while loading. | `true` | No |
| `fallback` | `ReactNode` | Shown instead of the image when it fails to load: an image icon and the built-in text ("Failed to load") by default. A failed image cannot be previewed. | — | No |
| `preview` | `boolean \| ImagePreviewOptions` | Opens a larger preview on click or `Enter` / `Space`; `false` turns it off. The object form sets the address of the preview and makes it controlled. | `true` | No |
| `fit` | `'cover' \| 'contain'` | How the image fills a `width` × `height` area: `cover` crops it, `contain` shows all of it. | `'cover'` | No |
| `radius` | `'none' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Corner radius: `md` for thumbnails in lists and forms, `lg` for cards, `none` for images that fill an area. | `'md'` | No |
| `width` | `number \| string` | Width of the image: a number in pixels or a CSS length. | — | No |
| `height` | `number \| string` | Height of the image: a number in pixels or a CSS length. | — | No |
| `loading` | `'lazy' \| 'eager'` | `lazy` loads the image only when it comes near the visible area, for long lists of images. | `'eager'` | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### ImagePreviewOptions

Options of the preview.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | Address of the image shown in the preview, such as a larger version; the `src` of the image by default. | — | No |
| `open` | `boolean` | Whether the preview is open (controlled). | — | No |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | Called when the preview opens or closes. | — | No |
